result.reason: The redline adds clear express warranties, appropriately carves them out of the disclaimer, preserves the existing error-correction obligation, and provides all three remedies at Licensee’s election. It does not complete either level: the preferred durations, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty are absent; moreover, both levels require a Services warranty generally, while the operative language covers only Technical Support Services. The Software warranty is also narrowed to conformity “in all material respects,” rather than the unqualified documentation-conformity requirement. The edits are otherwise confined to the warranty issue and do not contradict unrelated terms.
